<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 134.10955, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈133.102 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈11 % M+1 intensity) indicates roughly ten carbon atoms. A formula that matches this exact mass is C₁₀H₁₃ (monoisotopic mass 133.1017 Da), which is within experimental error of the observed value. No oxygen or other heteroatoms are required to fit the mass. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₀H₁₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
